caseNameFull: Shapiro, Commissioner of Welfare of the State of Connecticut v. Thompson
attorneys: Harold M. Mulvey, Attorney General of Connecticut, and Francis J. MacGregor, Assistant Attorney General, for appellant., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General, and Elizabeth Palmer, Deputy Attorney General, for the State of California, as amicus curiae, in support of appellant.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. Conn. Motion of appellee for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted.
